question: ______ holds the Indian record for the most test matches as captain as of December 2020.
solution:
The correct answer is __**MS Dhoni.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__** 

__
 
• **Mahendra Singh Dhoni**__ is a former Indian international cricketer.
 
• MS Dhoni holds the Indian record for the most test matches as captain as of December 2020.
 __
 
• He captained the Indian national team in limited-overs formats from 2007 to 2017 and in Test cricket from 2008 to 2014.
 
• **M S Dhoni captained India in 60 Tests.**
 
• He has captained Team India in** 332 international games**, most matches played as captain in international cricket.
 
• He is the only captain in the history of cricket to **win all ICC trophies.**
 
• MS Dhoni retired from international cricket on** 15 August 2020.**
 
• Dhoni is only the 2nd Indian captain to win more than one Asia Cup after Mohammad Azharuddin.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

__
 
• **Kapil Dev** is a former Indian international cricketer.

 
 
• He captained India in the 1983 world cup.
 
• He captained India in 34 Tests.
 
 
 
• **Mohammad Azharuddin** captained India in 47 Tests.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e085a7f17645c801966c030eb44d69fae944b96fdb4c4077f5fba1bc2c24bc71.png] **Mistake Points__**

 
• **Virat Kohli** surpassed M.S. Dhoni for most matches as India Test captain in June 2021.

 
 
• As of 2021 August, Virat Kohli captained India in 65 Tests.
